name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found 10 to 12 Nov
state: Cloudflare's status history for 10 and 11 Nov lists only regional network issues and product faults, all resolved, with no global incident (Cloudflare Status). An outage tracker found no internet-wide outage on 9 or 10 Nov (IsInternetUp). Searches on 12 Nov found no major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No widespread disruption to online services, payments or airline systems was found. Service status pages give the latest on any single provider.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour cloud/CDN/payments outage in past 48h = Normal
why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
